fraction_reason: Frozen before V2 hashing: historical 138 train / 184 total images = 0.75; no independent third evaluation population exists.
hash_rule: SHA256(dataset_protocol_name + source_group_id + '2026'); sort ascending; first floor(0.75*N) groups are train
oof_rule: V2 TRAIN groups with labeled detector images sorted by SHA256(protocol_name + group_id + '2026' + 'OOF5'); round-robin fold 0..4; normal-only groups are not teacher training samples
unknown_lineage_policy: singleton unless an allowed evidenced edge links it; physical_source_complete=false
label_boundary: dataset-defined supervision; not universally human-verified ground truth
future_claim: utility under the frozen Plastic_Bomo V2 annotation protocol
normal_policy: Only V2 TRAIN normals with explicit empty-part XML source metadata or byte-bound documented origin; unresolved normals excluded from confirmatory use
official_validation_use_definition: No model evaluation, design/tuning, candidate/quality selection or performance-based split selection; historical evaluation images/labels may be read ONLY to construct the explicitly requested new registry and count annotations
